expectedDetectionReport.rule: active true red/blue/obstacle, camera planar range inclusive 30..85 cm and abs(horizontal bearing)<=30 degrees
expectedDetectionReport.matching: for each eligible truth object, at least one bridge detection of its category in that frame
expectedDetectionReport.limitation: Class presence is not instance recall. One output may witness multiple eligible same-class objects; those frames are explicitly listed.

note: Only content equality and nonempty four-class detections are task gates; recall, repeated detections, record and pixel determinism, and checkpoint waveform are not gates in the revised task.
